messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: latency-regression detected on /v1/chat (p95 780ms, threshold 400ms). severity=P1. paging @nina oncall.
nina: I'm oncall. joining call. initial peek shows global p95 spike starting ~03:14 UTC, p50 flat.
omar: flagged hosts: gpu-pool-a-12..17 showing runqueue creep and long scheduling delays
felix: traces: a bunch of token-gen spans show long preemptions before model start:
```
trace_id=0x7a3c start=03:12:58 route=/v1/chat
  span: input-parse 12ms
  span: token-queue-wait 310ms
  span: model-exec 220ms
  note: tail shows wait before model-exec, not model CPU itself
```
jess: customer impact: three heavy-traffic tenants observed 40-60% request latency inflation in window 03:12-03:40; no errors, just tail latency.
kai: FYI we shipped node kernel 6.2.4->6.2.6 patch to all gpu pools at 01:55, with a canary of 5 nodes earlier. some nodes rolled automatically via rolling-update window.
nina: collecting perf metrics. @ops-bot run `collect --hosts gpu-pool-a-12-17 --metrics runq_len,ctx_switch,irq --since 03:00 --until 03:30`
ops-bot: accepted. attaching aggregate CSV in ~45s.
omar: raw snippet from host gpu-pool-a-15: `runq_len=9, ctx_switch/s=4200, softirq=2100` baseline runq_len~1-2 ctx_switch/s~650
felix: also seeing boosted `sched_wakeup` to `sched_wakeup_posted` latencies in tracepoints.
nina: hypotheses we should capture: H1 kernel scheduler tuning in 6.2.6 increased wake_latency under many runnable tasks H2 recent workload change increased short-lived threads leading to convoys H3 NIC driver/IRQ affinity changes causing CPU pinning and uneven scheduling H4 userland futex contention amplified by scheduler change
jess: mitigation options: A) rollback kernel to 6.2.4 on affected hosts B) enable task isolation flags on model-serving pods C) route traffic to secondary pools D) enable quantized fallback for a subset of traffic
kai: starting controlled downgrade of kernel on 2 worst nodes (gpu-pool-a-15,16) -> rollback job id rb-2734503210-01 kicked at 03:25 UTC
ops-bot: rollback job rb-2734503210-01 status=running node gpu-pool-a-15
felix: while rollback running, trying soft mitigation: pinning model threads to isolated cpus on canary (pod annotation).
omar: pinned canary shows immediate drop in runqueue on host (9->3) and token-queue-wait reduced from 310ms->80ms for pinned requests
nina: nice. scaling extra instances in pool to spread load +20% at 03:28
jess: customer comms drafted: short note saying degraded tail latency; mitigations in progress; no retries or errors detected. Sending to impacted tenants.
ops-bot: perf collect completed: /artifacts/perf-2734503210-aggregate.csv
kai: rollback job completed on gpu-pool-a-15 at 03:38, on a-16 at 03:41. post-rollback runq_len median 1-3, ctx_switch/s back to ~700
felix: tracing after rollback shows p95 back to ~210ms for rolled hosts; global p95 trending to 230ms (some hosts still noisy)
nina: updated hypotheses: H1 primary candidate. H3 still plausible but less supported. Need kernel config diff and scheduler params between builds.
omar: digging into tracepoint deltas: `sched_wakeup` -> `__sched_try_to_wake_up` path shows extra checks in 6.2.6 we didn't have before, exacerbates latency when many tasks wake.
jess: operational impact summary for P1 ticket: duration 03:12-03:50 active, mitigations applied 03:25-03:41, rollback key step 03:38, residual monitoring until 04:10.
kai: plan: repro on staging with 6.2.6 using synthetic workload of 1000 short tasks/sec to match observed load; test toggles: CONFIG_PREEMPT=y, SCHED_AUTOGROUP flags, IRQ affinity settings.
ops-bot: collecting traces for window 03:10-03:45 into trace-archive-2734503210 (job queued)
felix: assign owners: RCA doc owner @omar, kernel config diff @kai, reproducer @felix, customer followup @jess, mitigation ops @nina
nina: adding timeline to RCA doc: alert at 03:14, mitigation start 03:25, rollback complete 03:41, p95 normalized 03:50
omar: note for RCA: p50 unchanged throughout, p95 shift +450ms -> points to scheduler tail behaviors not model vCPU saturation
jess: will send tenant follow-ups with timeline and action items in 1h.
ops-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring
kai: one more ask: gather identical perf snapshot from an unaffected pool for comparison (gpu-pool-b-01..03)
felix: got a copy and attached to RCA: /artifacts/perf-baseline-2734503210.csv
nina: thanks team. we'll turn this into a formal postmortem once RCA owners consolidate findings and validate reproducer.
